constraints.name: C8_eval_contract_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE(((revision > 0) AND ("contractVersion" = 1) AND (jsonb_typeof("scopeJson") = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof("casesJson") = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length("casesJson") <= 5000) AND (jsonb_typeof("countsJson") = 'object'::text)), false))

constraints.name: C8_eval_hashes_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE(((("modelManifestHash" IS NULL) OR ("modelManifestHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("identityHash" IS NULL) OR ("identityHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("intentHash" IS NULL) OR ("intentHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("evaluationContractHash" IS NULL) OR ("evaluationContractHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("leaseTokenHash" IS NULL) OR ("leaseTokenHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("snapshotHash" IS NULL) OR ("snapshotHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("evidenceHash" IS NULL) OR ("evidenceHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))), false))

constraints.name: C8_eval_mode_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE((mode = ANY (ARRAY['OFFLINE_BACKTEST'::text, 'PROSPECTIVE'::text, 'DRIFT'::text])), false))

constraints.name: C8_eval_outcome_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE((((state = 'PENDING'::text) AND (outcome IS NULL) AND ("metricsJson" IS NULL) AND ("calibrationJson" IS NULL) AND ("driftJson" IS NULL) AND ("reasonsJson" IS NULL)) OR ((state <> 'PENDING'::text) AND (outcome = ANY (ARRAY['PASS'::text, 'FAIL'::text, 'INSUFFICIENT_DATA'::text, 'NOT_YET_OBSERVED'::text])) AND ((outcome <> 'PASS'::text) OR ((state = 'PUBLISHED'::text) AND ("metricsJson" IS NOT NULL) AND ("calibrationJson" IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE((("countsJson" ->> 'qualified'::text))::integer, 0) > 0))) AND ((outcome <> ALL (ARRAY['INSUFFICIENT_DATA'::text, 'NOT_YET_OBSERVED'::text])) OR ((state = 'UNAVAILABLE'::text) AND ("metricsJson" IS NULL) AND ("calibrationJson" IS NULL))))), false))

constraints.name: C8_eval_publication_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE((((state = 'PENDING'::text) AND ("publishedAt" IS NULL) AND ("snapshotHash" IS NULL)) OR ((state <> 'PENDING'::text) AND ("publishedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("publishedAt" >= "admittedAt") AND ("snapshotHash" IS NOT NULL) AND ("reasonsJson" IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof("reasonsJson") = 'array'::text) AND ("leaseTokenHash" IS NULL) AND ("leaseExpiresAt" IS NULL))), false))

constraints.name: C8_eval_state_lease_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE(((state = ANY (ARRAY['PENDING'::text, 'PUBLISHED'::text, 'UNAVAILABLE'::text])) AND ("leaseGeneration" >= 0) AND ((("leaseTokenHash" IS NULL) AND ("leaseExpiresAt" IS NULL)) OR (("leaseTokenHash" IS NOT NULL) AND ("leaseExpiresAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("leaseExpiresAt" <= "expiresAt") AND (state = 'PENDING'::text)))), false))

constraints.name: C8_eval_target_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE(("targetKey" = ANY (ARRAY['attended_return'::text, 'appointment_no_show'::text, 'client_expected_value'::text, 'business_revenue'::text, 'staff_earnings_conditional'::text, 'observed_booking_demand'::text, 'scheduled_utilization'::text, 'statistical_deviation'::text])), false))

constraints.name: C8_eval_tenant_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Tenant"(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: C8_eval_time_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE((("expiresAt" > "admittedAt") AND ("expiresAt" <= ("admittedAt" + '8760:00:00'::interval)) AND ("t0From" <= "t0To") AND ("t0To" <= "labelsAsOf") AND ("labelsAsOf" <= "admittedAt")), false))

constraints.name: C8_model_contract_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE(((version > 0) AND ("contractVersion" = 1) AND ((length("modelKey") >= 1) AND (length("modelKey") <= 120))), false))

constraints.name: C8_model_hashes_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE(((("manifestHash" IS NULL) OR ("manifestHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("artifactHash" IS NULL) OR ("artifactHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("featureContractHash" IS NULL) OR ("featureContractHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("evaluationContractHash" IS NULL) OR ("evaluationContractHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("releaseDigest" IS NULL) OR ("releaseDigest" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("requestKeyHash" IS NULL) OR ("requestKeyHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("intentHash" IS NULL) OR ("intentHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))), false))

constraints.name: C8_model_mode_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE(("trainingMode" = ANY (ARRAY['PROSPECTIVE'::text, 'QUALIFIED_BACKTEST'::text])), false))

constraints.name: C8_model_payload_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof("targetJson") = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof("scopeJson") = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof("methodJson") = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof("parametersJson") = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof("trainingEvidenceJson") = 'object'::text) AND (("targetJson" ->> 'targetKey'::text) = "targetKey") AND (("scopeJson" ->> 'tenantId'::text) = "tenantId") AND (length(("methodJson" ->> 'methodKey'::text)) > 0)), false))

constraints.name: C8_model_target_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE(("targetKey" = ANY (ARRAY['attended_return'::text, 'appointment_no_show'::text, 'client_expected_value'::text, 'business_revenue'::text, 'staff_earnings_conditional'::text, 'observed_booking_demand'::text, 'scheduled_utilization'::text, 'statistical_deviation'::text])), false))

constraints.name: C8_model_tenant_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Tenant"(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: C8_model_time_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE((("expiresAt" > "admittedAt") AND ("expiresAt" <= ("admittedAt" + '8760:00:00'::interval)) AND ("informationCutoffAt" <= "admittedAt")), false))

constraints.name: C8_result_contract_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE(((revision > 0) AND ("contractVersion" = 1) AND ("ruleVersion" > 0) AND ((length("ruleKey") >= 1) AND (length("ruleKey") <= 120))), false))

constraints.name: C8_result_eligibility_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE(((completeness = ANY (ARRAY['COMPLETE'::text, 'PARTIAL'::text, 'UNAVAILABLE'::text, 'NOT_MEASURED'::text])) AND (qualification = ANY (ARRAY['VERIFIED'::text, 'SOURCE_LABELLED'::text, 'UNQUALIFIED'::text])) AND (eligibility = ANY (ARRAY['ELIGIBLE'::text, 'INSUFFICIENT_DATA'::text, 'UNSUPPORTED'::text, 'INELIGIBLE'::text])) AND ((state <> 'UNAVAILABLE'::text) OR (("valuesJson" IS NULL) AND ("rankingJson" IS NULL))) AND ((kind <> 'PREDICTION'::text) OR (state <> 'PUBLISHED'::text) OR ((eligibility = 'ELIGIBLE'::text) AND (completeness = 'COMPLETE'::text) AND (qualification = 'VERIFIED'::text) AND ("modelVersionId" IS NOT NULL)))), false))

constraints.name: C8_result_hashes_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE(((("identityHash" IS NULL) OR ("identityHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("intentHash" IS NULL) OR ("intentHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("modelManifestHash" IS NULL) OR ("modelManifestHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("policyContentHash" IS NULL) OR ("policyContentHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("inputHash" IS NULL) OR ("inputHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("leaseTokenHash" IS NULL) OR ("leaseTokenHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("snapshotHash" IS NULL) OR ("snapshotHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))), false))

constraints.name: C8_result_kind_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE((kind = ANY (ARRAY['OBSERVED_VALUE'::text, 'POLICY_SIGNAL'::text, 'PREDICTION'::text, 'SCENARIO'::text, 'RANKING'::text])), false))

constraints.name: C8_result_lease_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE((("leaseGeneration" >= 0) AND ((("leaseTokenHash" IS NULL) AND ("leaseExpiresAt" IS NULL)) OR (("leaseTokenHash" IS NOT NULL) AND ("leaseExpiresAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("leaseExpiresAt" <= "expiresAt") AND (state = 'PENDING'::text)))), false))

constraints.name: C8_result_payload_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof("scopeJson") = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof("inputSnapshotJson") = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof("evidenceRefsJson") = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length("evidenceRefsJson") <= 5000) AND ((("modelVersionId" IS NULL) AND ("modelManifestHash" IS NULL)) OR (("modelVersionId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("modelManifestHash" IS NOT NULL) AND (kind = 'PREDICTION'::text))) AND (("rankingJson" IS NULL) OR (kind = 'RANKING'::text)) AND ((currency IS NULL) OR (currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'::text)) AND ((basis <> ALL (ARRAY['confirmed_cash'::text, 'confirmed_refunds'::text, 'confirmed_cash_net_linked_refunds'::text, 'booked_value'::text, 'provider_reported_gross'::text])) OR (currency IS NOT NULL)) AND (("valuesJson" IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof("valuesJson") = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(("valuesJson" -> 'values'::text)) = 'array'::text))) AND ((state <> 'PENDING'::text) OR (("valuesJson" IS NULL) AND ("uncertaintyJson" IS NULL) AND ("reasonsJson" IS NULL) AND ("rankingJson" IS NULL)))), false))

constraints.name: C8_result_publication_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE((((state = 'PENDING'::text) AND ("publishedAt" IS NULL) AND ("snapshotHash" IS NULL)) OR ((state <> 'PENDING'::text) AND ("publishedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("publishedAt" >= "admittedAt") AND ("snapshotHash" IS NOT NULL) AND ("reasonsJson" IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof("reasonsJson") = 'array'::text) AND ("leaseTokenHash" IS NULL) AND ("leaseExpiresAt" IS NULL))), false))

constraints.name: C8_result_state_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE((state = ANY (ARRAY['PENDING'::text, 'PUBLISHED'::text, 'UNAVAILABLE'::text])), false))

constraints.name: C8_result_subject_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE((("subjectKind" = ANY (ARRAY['client'::text, 'appointment'::text, 'staff'::text, 'branch'::text, 'tenant'::text, 'cohort'::text])) AND ((length("subjectId") >= 1) AND (length("subjectId") <= 240))), false))

constraints.name: C8_result_tenant_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Tenant"(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: C8_result_time_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE((("expiresAt" > "admittedAt") AND ("expiresAt" <= ("admittedAt" + '8760:00:00'::interval)) AND ("periodFrom" < "periodTo") AND ("periodTo" <= t0) AND (t0 <= "admittedAt") AND (("horizonEnd" IS NULL) OR ("horizonEnd" > t0)) AND ((kind <> 'PREDICTION'::text) OR ("horizonEnd" IS NOT NULL))), false))
